verdict.rationale: YYLO is itself a command-line orchestrator for coding agents. It ships an official npm-installed CLI (`@yylo/cli`, `yylo init`, `yy` subcommands such as ledger, loop, continue, pi, task start, merge land, and doctor workspace), all documented in first-party docs and the GitHub README. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and the repo (the CLI is also at an early 0.2.x version).
